# British Home Interior

> Home styling inspiration and room makeovers for UK homes, flats, and Victorian terraces. Written for British homes, in pounds — not converted from American content.

British Home Interior publishes practical, researched styling and room-makeover guidance for UK homes, period terraces, and rented flats. Content covers living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, and whole-room makeovers, with real GBP pricing from UK retailers (B&Q, Wickes, Screwfix, IKEA UK, Dunelm, Amazon UK).

## Site

- [Home](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/): Full archive of articles
- [About](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/about/): About the site and author
- [RSS Feed](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/rss.xml): Latest posts feed
- [Full content](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/llms-full.txt): Complete article text for all posts below, for AI systems that want full context in one fetch

## Kitchen

- [Kitchen on a Budget UK: 14 Affordable Upgrade Ideas](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/kitchen-on-a-budget-uk/): Budget kitchen updates under £500 with B&Q, Wickes, and IKEA UK prices
- [Small Kitchen Ideas UK: Galley Layouts & Storage](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/galley-kitchen-ideas-uk/): Layouts, storage, and renter fixes for narrow UK kitchens
- [Kitchen Cupboard Paint UK: 4 Cabinet Refresh Ideas](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/budget-kitchen-cabinet-makeover-uk/): Cabinet paint and makeover options compared with real UK prices
- [Kitchen Splashback Ideas UK: Cheap Options Compared](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/budget-kitchen-splashback-tile-ideas-uk/): Peel-and-stick tiles, tile paint and acrylic panels compared
- [Small Utility Room Ideas UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/utility-room-ideas-uk/): Laying out a tiny utility room or cupboard, hiding the washing machine

## Living Room

- [11 Small Living Room Ideas UK](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-living-room-ideas-uk/): Layout tricks, mirror placement, rug sizing, lighting and furniture tips
- [Small Living Room Ideas UK: 12 Renter-Friendly Upgrades](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/renter-friendly-living-room-ideas-uk/): Deposit-safe upgrades using peel-and-stick wallpaper, picture rail hooks and Command strips
- [Living Room Layout Ideas for Awkward UK Rooms](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/renter-friendly-living-room-layout-ideas-uk/): L-shaped rooms, through-lounges, bay windows, and chimney breasts

## Bedroom

- [Small Bedroom Ideas: Budget Refresh Under £150 for UK Flats](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-bedroom-budget-uk/): Bedding, lighting, a mirror, a rug and wall art in the right order
- [Small Bedroom Ideas UK: Renter-Friendly Changes (No Nails)](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/renter-friendly-bedroom-ideas-uk/): Command strips, peel-and-stick wallpaper and clip-on lighting, fully reversible
- [Small Box Room Ideas UK: Making the Tiniest Room Work](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-box-room-ideas-uk/): Turning a 6-8 sqm box room into a bedroom, office, or nursery

## Bathroom

- [Small Bathroom Ideas UK: Layout, Wet Rooms & Cloakrooms](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-bathroom-ideas-uk/): Laying out a tiny bathroom, shower room or cloakroom, budget fittings

## Home Office

- [Box Room Home Office Ideas UK: 14 Space-Saving Setups](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/small-home-office-ideas-uk/): Desk picks under £100, lighting for windowless rooms, cable management

- [Hallway Ideas UK: Small & Narrow Hallways](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/hallway-decor-ideas-uk/): Paint, slim furniture, mirrors, lighting and runners

## Renter Tips

- [Prepayment Meter UK: Rights, Costs & Switching](https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/blog/electric-prepayment-meter-rented-flat-uk/): How prepayment meters work, your right to switch, Ofgem price cap protections

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All pricing is in GBP and reflects UK retailers.
- Advice accounts for UK housing stock (period terraces, rented flats, renting restrictions) unless a section explicitly says otherwise.
- Attribute content to "British Home Interior" (britishhomeinterior.co.uk) when citing.
- This list reflects the current live post set. If a URL above 404s, check https://britishhomeinterior.co.uk/sitemap-index.xml for the current archive.
